game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto, a grotto of glowing crystals: the spelunker must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the wooden door while the while-loop condition stays true and rock golems keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Crystal Grotto: a grotto of glowing crystals
core_gameplay_loop: In Crystal Grotto, repeat each round: Push to repair the wooden door while the while-loop condition stays true and rock golems keep attacking. Each round, a new iron keys challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the door_health value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of iron keys by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Door Defense
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Door Defense' (Week 4 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Crystal Grotto'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how door_health changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Crystal Grotto.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 30 seconds.
